facts.value: Because people have unlimited wants but limited resources, economists study how societies allocate resources for production, distribution, and consumption.
Microeconomics focuses on the choices made by individuals and businesses.
Macroeconomics examines the economy as a whole and broader economic trends.
Economic ideas have existed for thousands of years, but modern economics is often traced to Adam Smith's 1776 book, An Inquiry Into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations.
